info.title: Comply API
info.description:
Comply is a multi-tenant audit-evidence portal for NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001, and the EU AI Act. This contract covers the REST API, the authentication flow, and the MCP JSON-RPC endpoint.

## Authentication

REST requests select the tenant with `x-comply-tenant`. Sign-in endpoints return a signed session token; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <session>`. MCP clients send a tenant-bound key as `Authorization: Bearer sk_mcp_<tenant>_<hex>`.

## Content

Requirements come from the managed library. Customers read them and cannot edit the source material. Assessment state is stored per tenant and survives a restart.

## MCP

The MCP endpoint uses JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP. Call `tools/list` for the current tool schemas. The guided journey is `start_assessment`, `set_scope`, `get_brief`, `submit_evidence`, `complete_requirement`, `review_assessment`, and `export_assessment`.

post.description:
Streamable HTTP MCP over JSON-RPC 2.0. Send a tenant-bound key as `Authorization: Bearer sk_mcp_<tenant>_<hex>`. Supported methods are `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, and `prompts/list`.

### Tools

- `get_agent_guide` returns the workflow and language policy.
- `start_assessment` creates a NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001, or AI Act assessment.
- `list_assessments` reconnects to a previous run with pagination.
- `get_assessment_state` returns the phase, progress, blockers, and next actions.
- `set_scope` stores the English scope and period.
- `get_brief` returns up to five prioritized requirements.
- `list_requirements` paginates the checklist with status and text filters.
- `search_requirements` ranks the checklist by lexical similarity.
- `get_progress` reports status and theme progress.
- `get_requirement` returns one requirement, its evidence, and the question to ask.
- `submit_evidence` records an artifact with an English summary and citation.
- `complete_requirement` accepts a requirement with an English conclusion.
- `mark_not_applicable` records an English reason.
- `review_assessment` is blocked while requirements are open.
- `export_assessment` produces the English package with a manifest hash.

tenantHeader.name: x-comply-tenant
tenantHeader.description: Tenant selector for the REST API. The value must match the tenant that owns the data.

session.description: Signed session token returned by the sign-in endpoints.

mcpKey.description: Tenant-bound MCP key with the form sk_mcp_<tenant>_<64 hex characters>.

TenantHeader.name: x-comply-tenant
TenantHeader.description: Tenant identifier. Development installs default to `nordwind` when omitted.
